title: test-coverage
description: Behaviours → the tests that pin them down. A behaviour without tests is shown as “not covered”: list it rather than leave it out. Not rendered when `behaviors` is empty. With `mode: "diff"` (explain-pr) the rows are the `read` and `skim` fragments of the page's `changes` blocks, each with its test or “not covered”; the block then lists the test files the change touches in `files` instead of `behaviors`.

mode.description: `explain` (default): rows are `behaviors`. `diff`: rows are the fragments of the `changes` blocks; give `files`, not `behaviors`.

files.description: `mode: "diff"`: the test files the change touches (they need no layer). `repo` is the head repo, needed when the page diffs more than one.

id.description: Part id, unique in the block; a route step can focus it.

tests.description: Tests that fail when the behaviour breaks; empty when none do.

note.description: For an uncovered behaviour: why, or what would cover it.
